update.statement_tex: Prove the physical symmetric-profile-limit bound sum_(hq<=N_X)^* chi_4(q)(hq)^(-3/4) H^prof_(infinity,X)(h,q) <<_epsilon X^epsilon, with N_X=floor(16sqrt X) and every actual scale, height floor, Vaaler factor, and stationary endpoint star retained. Its grouped coefficient is exactly C_X^*(n) from GAR, but e(sqrt(Xn)) is replaced by the constant endpoint phase e(sqrt(XN_X)); it is a full dephased prefix, not a thin endpoint subtotal. The direct-profile pointwise bound gives only normalized O(X^(1/8)log^2 X), hence physical O(X^(3/8)log^2 X). A promising distinct route is fixed-scale Abel summation in q against the bounded partial sums of chi_4, after proving uniform BV and cutoff control for the actual q-profile. Finite top-profile truncations are intermediate contour objects and are not silently identified with the physical limit.
